name: Wakad
summary: A fast-growing residential neighbourhood in Pimpri-Chinchwad, between Hinjewadi to the west and Pimple Saudagar and Aundh to the east.
knownFor: Adjoins Hinjewadi's Rajiv Gandhi Infotech Park
Mhatoba temple and its annual jatra
Growing number of colleges and schools
connectivity: Katraj-Dehu bypass, Bhumkar Chowk Road and Datta Mandir Road
BRT routes including Nashik Phata-Wakad and Aundh-Ravet
Pune Metro Line 3 (Hinjewadi-Shivajinagar) has a station at Wakad Chowk, open since 4 November 2026
suits: IT professionals working in Hinjewadi who want a cosmopolitan residential area with established amenities.
